title: Copy button
summary: Copies a value to the clipboard and confirms in place. Put it beside identifiers people paste elsewhere: MRNs, member IDs, claim numbers, links.

demos.title: Inline
demos.note: Press it: the icon swaps to a tick for two seconds and the accessible name changes to Copied. label is required because the button has no text.
